# SkePU-BLAS API {#sec-skepublas}

This appendix chapter documents the SkePU-BLAS coverage and API
interface as in [@Ernstsson2022PhD]. Currently, the SkePU-BLAS coverage
is limited to level-1 BLAS and dense operations from level 2 and 3.
Unsupported level-2 and level-3 BLAS functions are omitted below for
brevity.

SkePU-BLAS replaces the character arguments in CBLAS with C++-style
type-safe `enum`s:

    enum class Op : char { NoTrans = 'N', Trans = 'T', ConjTrans = 'C' }; 

The following subsections contain the complete API specification for
SkePU-BLAS, showing equivalence to one or several CBLAS functions in
each case.

All SkePU-BLAS functions below are namespaced under `skepu::blas`, and
signatures are defined in header `skepu-lib/blas`.

An example of using SkePU-BLAS, Conjugate Gradient computing, is given
in @sec-CG.

## Level 0 BLAS Functions

### Setup Givens rotation: `rotg`

CBLAS functions: SROTG, DROTG, CROTG, ZROTG

SkePU-BLAS signature:

```cpp
template<typename T>
void rotg (T *a, T *b, T *c, T *s)
```

### Apply Givens rotation: `rot`

CBLAS functions: SROT, DROT, CSROT, ZDROT

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY,
         typename TS = scalar_type<TX, TY>>
void rot (
 size_type n,
 Vector<TX> & x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> & y,
 stride_type incy,
 TS c,
 TS s
)
```

The BLAS functionality \"Setup modified Givens rotation\" (CBLAS
functions SROTMG, DROTMG) and \"Apply modified Givens rotation\" (CBLAS
functions SROTM, DROTM) is currently not supported yet in SkePU-BLAS.

### Swap x and y: `swap`

CBLAS functions: SSWAP, DSWAP, CSWAP, ZSWAP

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY>
void swap (
 size_type n,
 Vector<TX> & x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> & y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

## Level 1 BLAS Functions

### Vector scaling: `scal`

$x := a * x$

CBLAS functions: SSCAL, DSCAL, CSSCAL, CSCAL

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TS>
void scal (
 size_type n,
 TS alpha,
 Vector<TX> & x,
 stride_type incx
)
```

### Vector copy: `copy`

$y := x$

CBLAS functions: SCOPY, DCOPY, CCOPY, ZCOPY

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY>
 void copy (
 size_type n,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> & y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

### AXPY: `axpy`

$y := a * x + y$

CBLAS functions: SAXPY, CAXPY, DAXPY, ZAXPY

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY,
         typename TS = scalar_type<TX, TY>>
void axpy (
 size_type n,
 TS alpha,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> & y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

### Dot product: `dot`

CBLAS functions: SDOT, DDOT, CDOTC, ZDOTC

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY>
scalar_type<TX, TY> dot (
 size_type n,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> BLAS_CONST& y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

The BLAS functionality \"Dot product with extended precision
accumulation\" (CBLAS functions: DSDOT, SDSDOT) is currently not yet
supported in SkePU-BLAS.

### Dot product: `dotu`

CBLAS functions: CDOTU, ZDOTU

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY>
scalar_type<TX, TY> dotu (
 size_type n,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> BLAS_CONST& y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

### Euclidian norm: `nrm2`

CBLAS functions: SNRM2, DNRM2, SCNRM2, DZNRM2

```cpp
template<typename T>
real_type<T> nrm2 (
 size_type n,
 Vector<T> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx
)
```

### Sum of absolute values: `asum`

CBLAS functions: SASUM, DASUM, SCASUM, DZASUM

```cpp
template<typename T>
T asum (
 size_type n,
 Vector<T> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx
)
```

### Index of maximum absolute value: `iamax`

CBLAS functions: ISAMAX, IDAMAX, ICAMAX, IZAMAX

```cpp
template<typename T>
size_type iamax (
 size_type n,
 Vector<T> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx
)
```

## Level 2 BLAS Functions

### Matrix-vector multiply: `gemv`

CBLAS functions: SGEMV, DGEMV, CGEMV, ZGEMV

```cpp
template<typename TA, typename TX, typename TY,
         typename TS = scalar_type<TA, TX, TY>>
void gemv(
 blas::Op
 size_type m,
 size_type n,
 TS alpha,
 Matrix<TA> BLAS_CONST& A,
 size_type lda,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 TS beta,
 Vector<TY> & y,
 stride_type incy
)
```

### Rank-1 update: `ger`

CBLAS functions: SGER, DGER, CGERC, ZGERC

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY, typename TA,
         typename TS = scalar_type<TA, TX, TY>>
void ger (
 size_type m,
 size_type n,
 TS alpha,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> BLAS_CONST& y,
 stride_type incy,
 Matrix<TA> & A,
 stride_type lda
)
```

### Rank-1 update: `geru`

CBLAS functions: GCERU, ZGERU

```cpp
template<typename TX, typename TY, typename TA,
         typename TS = scalar_type<TA, TX, TY>>
void geru (
 size_type m,
 size_type n,
 TS alpha,
 Vector<TX> BLAS_CONST& x,
 stride_type incx,
 Vector<TY> BLAS_CONST& y,
 stride_type incy,
 Matrix<TA> & A,
 stride_type lda
)
```

## Level 3 BLAS Functions

### Matrix-matrix multiply: `gemm`

CBLAS functions: SGEMM, DGEMM, CGEMM, ZGEMM

```cpp
template<typename TA, typename TB, typename TC>
void gemm (
 blas::Op transA,
 blas::Op transB,
 size_type m,
 size_type n,
 size_type k,
 scalar_type<TA, TB, TC> alpha,
 Matrix<TA> BLAS_CONST& A,
 size_type lda,
 Matrix<TB> BLAS_CONST& B,
 size_type ldb,
 scalar_type<TA, TB, TC> beta,
 Matrix<TC>& C,
 size_type ldc
)
```

## Example: Conjugate-Gradient Solver {#sec-CG}

The following example code using SkePU-BLAS functions is adapted from
[@Ernstsson2022PhD].

```cpp
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>
#include <skepu-lib/blas.hpp>

template<typename T>
void conjugate_gradient(
 skepu::Matrix<T> BLAS_CONST& A,
 skepu::Vector<T> BLAS_CONST& b,
 skepu::Vector<T> &x)
{
 size_t N = b.size();
 assert(A.size_i() == N && A.size_j() == N && x.size() == N);
 skepu::Vector<T> p(N), r(N), Ap(N);
 // Set up initial r and p:
 skepu::blas::copy( N, b, 1, r, 1 );
 skepu::blas::gemv( skepu::blas::Op::NoTrans,
                    N, N, -1.f, A, N, x, 1, 1.f, r, 1 );
 skepu::blas::copy( N, r, 1, p, 1 );  // p := r
 float rTr = skepu::blas::dot( N, r, 1, r, 1 );  // rTr = r * r

 for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {

   // Compute alpha:
   skepu::blas::gemv( skepu::blas::Op::NoTrans,
                      N, N, 1.f, A, N, p, 1, 0.f, Ap, 1 );  // Ap := A * p
   float tmp = skepu::blas::dot( N, p, 1, Ap, 1 );  // tmp := p * Ap
   float alpha = rTr / tmp;

   // Update x:
   skepu::blas::axpy(N, alpha, p, 1, x, 1);  // x := x + alpha * p

   // Update r:
   skepu::blas::axpy( N, -alpha, Ap, 1, r, 1 );  // r := r - alpha * Ap

   // Compute beta:
   float rTr_new = skepu::blas::dot( N, r, 1, r, 1 );  // rTr_new  := r*r
   float beta = rTr_new / rTr;

   // Early exit condition:
   if (sqrt(rTr_new) < 1e-10f)
   return;

   // Update p:
   skepu::blas::scal( N, beta, p, 1 );  // p := beta * p
   skepu::blas::axpy( N, 1.f, r, 1, p, 1 );  // p := r + p
   rTr = rTr_new;
 }
}
```
